identity.name: Dormant Host Reconnaissance via Newly Seen Endpoint
identity.summary: An endpoint that has not previously connected to a dormant host initiates outbound network connections to it. Cortex detects this abnormal behavior as a potential reconnaissance or lateral movement at
identity.description: An endpoint that has not previously connected to a dormant host initiates outbound network connections to it. Cortex detects this abnormal behavior as a potential reconnaissance or lateral movement attempt.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Abnormal Dormant Host Connection
biocs.description: A newly seen endpoint makes an outbound connection to a dormant host that has not previously been contacted.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter actor_process_image_name != null
| filter not exists (select * from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50' and agent_hostname = agent_hostname)
| filter agent_hostname != null

abiocs.name: New Endpoint Connecting to Dormant Host
abiocs.description: Detects when a new endpoint makes an outbound network connection to a host that has not previously been contacted by any endpoint.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter actor_process_image_name != null
| filter not exists (select * from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50' and agent_hostname != agent_hostname)
| filter agent_hostname != null

xql_queries.name: Detect Dormant Host Connections
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter not exists (select * from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50' and agent_hostname = agent_hostname)
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname
